title: Quotient operations and congruences
proposed_reference_coverage: **Quotient operations: congruences and maps on equivalence classes**
fact_or_context_to_reference: Representative-independent unary and binary operations, unique factorization through a quotient, and the kernel-quotient-to-image bijection give the set-level pattern for algebraic quotient structures. An equivalence relation defines an algebraic congruence only when the relevant operations respect it. The ideal-of-errors quotient supplies this pattern for Boolean operations: the projection preserves operations and the fixed-region quotient is explicitly isomorphic to the remaining power set. These facts are proved locally. Ultraproducts extend representative independence to operations of every finite arity.
